title: Improving Generalization Robustness of Multimodal RLVR
abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) makes Multimodal Large Language Models more accurate, but the gains are brittle: simply paraphrasing a question or changing the prompt template can degrade them, which challenges reliable deployment in high-stakes scenarios like medical VQA. We trace this to two issues of the standard RL objective. First, the binary verifier conflates format with content, so the reward signal cannot tell a wrong answer apart from a misformatted one. Second, the training distribution covers only a thin slice of the real-world prompts that the model might meet at deployment, so policies that perform well on the training distribution can behave differently under unseen prompts during test. Both failures call for a robust post-training method that helps the policy cover a broader distribution of semantically equivalent prompts, and we identify two measures that help achieve this objective: separating format from semantics in the reward, and applying policy invariance across perturbed prompts with equivalent semantics. We therefore propose Prompt-Invariant RLVR (PIRL), consisting of a dynamic trinary reward and a consistency regularizer based on an embedding-space adversary. Under stress testing, PIRL's average accuracy on benchmarks drops by only $\le 1\%$, where GRPO drops ~3%. On dynamic evaluation, PIRL also achieves the smallest performance drop.

analysis.ideaZh: PIRL 针对 multimodal RLVR 的 prompt-template 脆弱性，把格式正确与语义正确拆成 dynamic trinary reward，再用 embedding-space adversary 和 clean/perturbed consistency 约束策略；作者在两种 Qwen-VL backbone、考试/医疗/法律七个 benchmark 上报告 template stress degradation 明显小于 GRPO，但 dynamic test 仍存在很大绝对下降，方法改善的是相对鲁棒性而非解决 prompt shift。
analysis.whyRelevantZh: 它直接推进 MLLM post-training 的稳定性，并给出把 format compliance 与 semantic correctness 分开的可迁移 reward design，对视觉推理与 design-agent instruction robustness 都有参考价值。
analysis.evidenceZh: PIRL 同时优化格式/语义奖励分解与 prompt invariance。（Sec. 3 and Fig. 2, p. 5）；作者报告 PIRL 在两种 backbone 的七项 template-stress 平均 gap 小于 GRPO。（Table 1, p. 7; Fig. 5, p. 32）；消融显示 multi-template、DTR 与 adversarial prompting 对 stress robustness 有互补贡献。（Table 3, p. 8）；dynamic-test 的 MathVista 等绝对性能仍大幅降低。（Table 2, p. 8）
analysis.caveatZh: 作者限制：Invariance 只覆盖 instruction-embedding 邻域，不等同完整 semantic-equivalence class。；作者限制：理论结果基于 population assumptions，7B–8B 的有限规模不能保证更大模型 scaling。；审阅风险：Dynamic-test 某些任务的绝对性能崩塌仍严重，不能把最小 gap 写成部署稳健性已解决。；审阅风险：医疗/法律 benchmark 只验证答案准确率与 prompt shift，没有真实高风险 calibration 或 safety study。
analysis.motivationZh: 标准 binary verifier 会把格式错误和答案错误混为一谈，训练格式又只覆盖真实 prompts 的薄切片。PIRL 用 DTR 分离 delimiter validity、answer correctness 与 semantic partial credit，用 DAN 调整 group advantage；同时在 instruction embeddings 邻域寻找低奖励 perturbation，对 adversarial/clean token distribution 加 KL consistency，并在五模板池训练。实验覆盖 Qwen2.5-VL-7B、Qwen3-VL-8B，七个 exam/medical/legal VQA benchmarks、template stress 和更广的 dynamic operator stress。
analysis.methodZh: 标准 binary verifier 会把格式错误和答案错误混为一谈，训练格式又只覆盖真实 prompts 的薄切片。PIRL 用 DTR 分离 delimiter validity、answer correctness 与 semantic partial credit，用 DAN 调整 group advantage；同时在 instruction embeddings 邻域寻找低奖励 perturbation，对 adversarial/clean token distribution 加 KL consistency，并在五模板池训练。实验覆盖 Qwen2.5-VL-7B、Qwen3-VL-8B，七个 exam/medical/legal VQA benchmarks、template stress 和更广的 dynamic operator stress。 真正的新意是把 reward entanglement 与 prompt population coverage 明确分成两个 design condition，并用 DTR/DAN 与 adversarial invariance 分别实例化；单独 multi-template augmentation、GRPO 或 adversarial training 并不新。理论给出 population-level 条件与 coverage-transfer bound，但实际 per-token KL 只是 sequence-level invariance 的 surrogate。
analysis.experimentsZh: 在 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 与 Qwen3-VL-8B 上以 GRPO、GRPO-MT、base model 比较；训练/ID/OOD 数据涵盖 MMK12、MathVista、OlympiadBench-Physics、RAD、PathVQA、GMAI 与 DocVQA，并构造五模板 stress 与多 operator dynamic test。 作者报告：作者报告 Qwen3-VL-8B PIRL 在标准测试为 60.9/72.0/27.4/78.8/50.0/46.3/73.1，T-Stress 对应 60.1/72.4/26.3/79.6/49.2/43.6/73.6。（Table 1, p. 7）；作者报告 D-Test 上 PIRL 的七项平均 gap 在训练方法中最小，但部分任务仍有显著绝对退化。（Table 2, p. 8） Baseline boundary：包含 standard GRPO、multi-template GRPO 与 base model，两种 backbone、多个域和 stress families；缺少其他 robust RLVR/semantic verifier 方法的直接比较，以及更大 MLLM 与生成式开放答案任务。 Ablation boundary：MT、ADV、DTR 的组合消融与 perturbation modality、template-count studies 支持组件作用；DAN、reward-adversary sampling 和 consistency coefficient 的独立敏感性仍不够完整。
analysis.insightZh: 真正的新意是把 reward entanglement 与 prompt population coverage 明确分成两个 design condition，并用 DTR/DAN 与 adversarial invariance 分别实例化；单独 multi-template augmentation、GRPO 或 adversarial training 并不新。理论给出 population-level 条件与 coverage-transfer bound，但实际 per-token KL 只是 sequence-level invariance 的 surrogate。 方法、理论和跨域 stress evaluation 足以收录并建议精读；摘要的“drop ≤1%”必须限于特定汇总口径，同时突出 dynamic stress 尚未解决。
